exposure: Very low birth weight of the second twin (<1500g)
cohort: 193 twin pregnancies where the second twin's birthweight was ≤1500 g
finding: Vaginal delivery of very low birthweight twins was associated with an increased risk of intraventricular hemorrhage, regardless of presentation.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery of very low birthweight twins was associated with an increased risk of intraventricular hemorrhage, regardless of presentation.
